limitations: Class-4 participants live in civilisations only through crucible.semantic.generalists.civ_world until civ lists pop_semantic in its ORDER (integration note); civ.generate alone leaves class-4 rows inert (DEF-D-5).

H.n1 fails by measurement: with the locally available checkpoints, situation interpretation (goal formation, argument choice) is effective only on Qwen3-1.7B on held-out SP-3.2b templates (0.6B 0.28), and routing tool choice and the next-step phrase to Qwen3-0.6B (reasoning first), effective on two DEV samples, failed held-out tool selection (H.4 0.514): class-4 decisions above 1.1B parameters are about a third or more of all decisions.
In-situ routing measurements use the DEV templates of one benchmark (72 items per sample); the TEST templates guard them once (H.4) and are not used to pick among variants.

Content quality of class-4 publications is low: small models often announce what they will write, prefix it ('Here is the text ...'), or leave JSON fragments; the runtime filter and the evaluator rule reject only texts with no content beyond such sentences, and the population's viewership does not judge writing quality (lexical legibility, DEF-B-6).
About half of class-4 calls are still refused (rerun: 0.49): wrong board names, empty messages, missing titles, repeated follows; refusals are part of the participants' histories.
No collaborative result between class-4 participants was verified in the reruns (no answered request, co-edited document or payment after a conversation).
SP-4.3 fails on word salad because the population judges legibility lexically (population.semantics, DEF-B-6, workstream B); the shared space's comprehension index separates it.
GPU bf16 batched inference is not bitwise reproducible across processes or batch compositions: fresh runs of the same spec diverge (replay of a recorded log is exact).

Cheap LM features (SmolLM2-135M coherence + distilled valence head) were measured not equivalent (valence Pearson 0.75 < 0.85) and not adopted; the space keeps Qwen3-0.6B (batched, cached by artifact hash).
Value filters (scaffolding echo, tool names, goal restatement, announcements, copy shares, one sampled rewrite), the evaluator's junk rule and the activation cadence are hand-set.
